case.intended_use: Descriptive characterization of the relationship between C-alpha distance observables from seeded MD trajectories and ATP-lid conformational descriptors reported in NMR experiments
case.scientific_claim: The available evidence supports only a descriptive correspondence between the C-alpha distance observable (residues 46-60) extracted from seeded MD trajectories and the ATP-lid conformational descriptors derived from solution NMR measurements. No validated forward model links the trajectory observables to NMR readouts. The physical conditions and estimand sampled by NMR experiments and MD simulations remain unestablished as congruent.

proposal.rationale: The permitted facts explicitly establish that (1) no validated numerical forward model exists from NMR readouts to MD-derived observables, and (2) the packet does not establish that NMR and seeded MD sample the same physical conditions or estimand. These constraints preclude any quantitative or inferential claims beyond descriptive correspondence. The trajectory observables (C-alpha distances) can be described in relation to the ATP-lid conformational descriptors from NMR, but no causal, predictive, or population-level claims are supported. Forbidden upgrades including state assignment, population estimation, and kinetic derivation must be explicitly refused. Additional evidence required to discriminate remaining interpretations would include: a validated forward model mapping NMR observables to MD distance metrics, demonstrated congruence of physical conditions (temperature, ionic strength, nucleotide state) between NMR and MD, and independent validation of the seed-lineage constructs against experimental measurements.
